directory_policies.notes.9: English policy: Application-date validity: TOEFL 80/120 or 4/6, IELTS 6.5 are lower qualifying levels; TOEFL 92/120 or 4.5/6, IELTS 7 clear ELP without AEP. Two-year validity applies at submission. Lower qualifying scores require AEP review and extra fees; no degree exemption or DET acceptance is inferred.

source_excerpt: valid on the date the application is submitted
fact_summary: UW test validity is measured at application submission or a deferral petition, not future enrollment. The recommended-score threshold clears ELP without AEP conditions; lower qualifying scores need review. DET program acceptance remains unconfirmed.
